final_answer:
It would take 100 machines 5 minutes to make 100 widgets. 

Here's why:  
If 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes, that means each machine produces 1 widget in 5 minutes. This rate (1 widget per machine per 5 minutes) remains consistent regardless of the number of machines.  

With 100 machines working simultaneously, each would produce 1 widget in 5 minutes. Thus, 100 machines would produce 100 widgets in the same 5 minutes.  

The key is that the time per widget per machine doesn’t change—it’s simply scaled up with more machines.
